mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 12-month moving averages signal a broad-based demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 35% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below 12mo MA, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average during a supply shock regime signals reduced corporate output and potential inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances during supply shocks (as defined by INDPRO decline), or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) relative to historical averages indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.025.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) and elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signal a weak labor market with restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market weakness with restrictive policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 35% of instances when both UNRATE > 6.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 1.0% during a late-cycle expansion regime signals economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 45% of instances during late-cycle expansions (as defined by GDPC1 growth < 1.0%), or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02.
